unit.why: A short memorate: R. Moshe passes on the rebbe's own account of a dead man's soul visiting him, a man who did not know he had died.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מהחסיד ר׳ משה שאמר לנו
stories.summary_en: The rebbe of Mogielnica tells R. Moshe that the soul of a man dead over a year, whom everyone (and he) thought a decent man, came to him that day, and the man seems not to know he has died and imagines he is still alive.

quotes: היום באה אצלי נשמה אחת הנפטר יותר משנה
tags.why: the soul of a dead man visits the tsaddik

quotes: כמדומה לי שעוד לא יודע שהוא נפטר
tags.why: the tsaddik perceives the dead man's spiritual state

quotes: הנה אספר לכם מה שסיפר לי היום מרן
tags.why: the story is framed as told by the rebbe and retold by a hasid

quotes: ובני העולם היו מחזיקין אותו לאדם כשר
tags.why: the man was thought decent, and his wandering soul implies otherwise

quotes: מה שסיפר לי היום מרן שלי״ט
tags.why: the rebbe confides in his hasid

missing_concepts: a dead man's soul unaware of its own death (wandering soul)
